title: The recap's Linga card counts the talks it does not draw
body:
## Summary
The recap's Linga card drew its last five conversations and dropped the rest silently, while the Math Buddy and Essay tiles say "n earlier".

## Description
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx RecapLinga sliced `t.talks.slice(-5)` with no Earlier line; RecapMaths and RecapEssay (desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:333 Earlier) count what they did not draw. The phone's line for the same tile (desk/src/tv/recapRows.ts:151) names every conversation, so TV and phone disagreed. Fixed: RECAP_TALKS = 5 and <Earlier n={talks - 5}/> under the card, styled for the cream card in desk/src/design/on-air.css.

## Flow
- Seven Linga conversations tonight -> Recap on the TV
- Before: five plum marks, nothing else; the phone says seven
- After: five marks and "2 earlier"

## Expected impact
A learner or parent reading the TV recap sees how many talks there were. Could break: the recap's golden hashes (unchanged, both under five talks).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the three recap tiles follow one rule for what they do not draw
Before: 7 talks -> 5 marks, 0 earlier lines (SW5 red)
After: 5 marks + "2 earlier"; 5 talks -> no line (SW5 green)
Method: gate - tools/tv-recap-test.cjs SW5 renders Recap server-side
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:357 (before) t.talks.slice(-5).map(...) with no <Earlier>
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:333 function Earlier - used by RecapMaths and RecapEssay only
tools/tv-recap-test.cjs SW5

title: The lesson ticker names Play and asks no circle on the phone
body:
## Summary
The shell's lesson ticker asked the learner to "circle on the phone" (no phone panel does) and to press "Space" (a bench key, not a remote button).

## Description
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:205 ticker: `paused — circle on the phone to ask about this frame` and `Space pauses`. tools/phone-panel-test.cjs:112 NO_PANEL records that no phone panel circles a lesson frame; the rail says "Press Play to start" (desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:34). On Air: the ticker carries facts, never sentences. Fixed: `paused|playing · Play resumes|Play pauses · Back returns`.

## Flow
- Open a lesson on English or Essay, press Play/Pause
- Before: the TV asks for a phone action that does not exist and names a key the remote lacks
- After: facts only, the remote's own button

## Expected impact
The learner is not sent to the phone for nothing. Math Buddy's lesson has the same copy (desk/src/maths/MathsTV.tsx:1082), carried as its own card.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - TV copy asserts only what the desk can do
Before: 2 of 3 ticker strings assert a capability the desk lacks (SW6 red)
After: 0 of 3 (SW6 green)
Method: gate - SW6 renders LessonScreen paused and playing
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The TV lets go of each spoken line's audio blob
body:
## Summary
The TV's speak effect minted a blob URL per spoken line and never revoked one.

## Description
desk/src/app/tv/page.tsx:95 `new Audio(URL.createObjectURL(blob))`, 0 revokeObjectURL in the file; desk/src/english/useEnglishAudio.ts:29 revokes its own. Every hint, explanation and verdict voiced stayed pinned in memory on the Fire TV Stick until reload. Registry: media-playback / media-resource-lifecycle (latest-wins with reap-on-replace). Fixed: the old blob is revoked when replaced and the current one on ended.

## Flow
- Voice on, an evening of hints
- Before: N lines -> N live blob URLs
- After: at most 1, 0 once it ends

## Expected impact
Lower steady memory on the Stick across a long evening. Could break: a line replaced mid-play is cut (as before: the old one was paused).

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - spoken audio blobs held
Before: 4 lines -> 4 live blob URLs (SW7 red)
After: 4 lines -> 1 live; 0 after ended (SW7 green)
Method: gate - SW7 runs the speak effect slice with stub URL/Audio
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The session stream's debug trace keeps its last 200 lines
body:
## Summary
useSession appended a debug line to window.__desk.events for every SSE message, forever, on the TV and the phone.

## Description
desk/src/tv/useSession.ts:17-23 pushed per message; the store ticks once a second while the clock runs (desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:862), so ~3600 strings an hour per page. Zero consumers: grep "__desk" over desk/src and tools finds only this write (the other hits are the server store's globalThis.__desk). Fixed: a trace() that keeps the last 200.

## Flow
- The TV stays open with the clock running
- Before: the array grows by one string per second without bound
- After: 200 lines, newest last

## Expected impact
Flat client memory over an evening. Could break: someone reading older trace lines from devtools sees only the last 200.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - unbounded client array
Before: 3 h of ticks -> 10801 lines (SW8 red)
After: 200 (SW8 green)
Method: gate - SW8 drives the effect slice with a fake EventSource
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/tv/useSession.ts:17 dbg.events.push(...) per message (before)
desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:862 timer.tick every second
grep __desk: no reader of window.__desk.events in desk/src or tools

title: An essay paragraph on the page screen ends in an ellipsis only when cut
body:
## Summary
PageScreen always appended "…" to an essay paragraph, cut or not.

## Description
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:139 `it.text.slice(0, 110) + "…"`; the lesson panel in the same file does it right (`l.text.length > 520 ? "…" : ""`, desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:203). Fixed to the same rule.

## Flow
- An essay page whose paragraph is under 110 characters
- Before: "Cats sleep a lot.…"
- After: shown whole

## Expected impact
The lower third stops implying text was withheld. Could break: nothing; long paragraphs cut exactly as before.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - truncation mark only on truncated text
Before: short paragraph drawn with "…" (SW9 red)
After: whole, no mark; 199 chars -> 110 + "…" (SW9 green)
Method: gate - SW9 renders PageScreen
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:139 (before)
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:203 the lesson's conditional ellipsis

title: On Air's stylesheet drops the rules no screen draws
body:
## Summary
desk/src/design/on-air.css carried 27 classes no className in desk/src draws, shipped on every route including the phone.

## Description
Math Buddy's topics/practice/walk/path/sheets moved to Lamplight, Essay's forensic and lens cards to Specimen, the calendar and the wipe went; their On Air rules stayed (desk/src/design/on-air.css, 291 lines). desk/src/app/globals.css:1 imports it on every page. Instrument built: a TypeScript-AST scan of className values (JSX attributes, className props, the consts they name) against the stylesheet's classes, comments stripped, seeded red. Note: the commit body says 27 of 111; the re-measured figure is 27 of 117.

## Flow
- Build the scan (SW10), run it on the old file: 27 undrawn
- Prune the rules whose every selector names an undrawn class; keep band-corner, .nothing, .rule
- Re-run: 0

## Expected impact
9.4 KB less CSS parsed on every TV and phone load, and a gate that stops On Air rules outliving their screens. Could break: a class built at runtime outside className (none found; markup unchanged).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - dead CSS shipped to every page
Before: 27 of 117 classes undrawn; 291 lines, 28011 bytes (SW10 red)
After: 0 of 84; 190 lines, 18640 bytes (SW10 green)
Method: gate - SW10 AST scan, seeded with a dead rule and with the same rule in a comment
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
undrawn before: band-left-thin row-focus extract notes cal cell wipe band-spine band-gauge band-shelf tiles tile qs x verdict wrote slipname path above nodes trk sq names verdict-line sheets lens track
tools/tv-recap-test.cjs SW10

title: Play/Pause on a lesson says paused while the video keeps playing
body:
## Summary
On the shell's lesson screen Play/Pause flips session.lessonPaused, but nothing tells the YouTube embed, so the TV says "paused" over a playing video.

## Description
desk/src/tv/keys.ts:402 posts lesson.pause; desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:654 sets the flag; desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:190,198 embeds youtube-nocookie with no enablejsapi and no postMessage; desk/src/lib/library/watched.ts:6 says the player never reports back. The ticker and the watched rule (which stops counting while 'paused') both read a state the player is not in. Registry: media-playback / engine-adapters - an application that owns transport must hold truthful playback state. Fix: enablejsapi=1 on the embed and a pauseVideo/playVideo command on lessonPaused changes (and the same for desk/src/maths/MathsTV.tsx).

## Flow
- Open a lesson with a video, press Play/Pause
- Observed (by code): ticker says paused; the iframe gets no command
- Fix: send the command; the watched clock then matches what played

## Expected impact
The learner's pause works; the watched tick stops crediting time the video was playing. Could break: autoplay policy on the Stick's browser.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the pause key pauses the video
Before: 0 of 1 pause paths reach the player (code read: no enablejsapi, no postMessage in desk/src)
After: predicted 1 of 1
Method: simulation - needs a browser with the YouTube iframe API; no dev server or device in this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:190,198 embed src without enablejsapi
desk/src/tv/keys.ts:402
desk/src/lib/library/watched.ts:6 "the desk's Pause (lessonPaused) is its own flag the player never reports back to"
grep enablejsapi|postMessage|pauseVideo desk/src: 0 hits
instrument: Playwright on a second dev server: open a lesson with a video, press Space, read player.getPlayerState() through the iframe API (enablejsapi=1): 1 (playing) today, 2 (paused) after

body:

## Description

No phone panel circles a frame (tools/phone-panel-test.cjs:112 NO_PANEL); the remote has no Space. Out of this round's paths (math-buddy context): the pair of SW6 now disagrees.

- The copy asks for what the desk cannot do
- Fix: Play resumes / Play pauses, as the shell now says

## Expected impact

## Evaluation
Claim: user - TV copy asserts only what the desk can do
Before: 2 strings in desk/src/maths/MathsTV.tsx:1082
After: 0 (predicted, as SW6 measured on the shell)
Method: simulation - out of scope for this round; SW6 is the instrument shape
Result: better

title: The TV re-binds its keydown listener on every session message
body:
## Summary
The TV page's D-pad effect depends on `s`, so every SSE message (one a second with the clock on) removes and re-adds the window keydown listener.

## Description
desk/src/app/tv/page.tsx:120-139 useEffect(..., [s, post, apply]) with addEventListener/removeEventListener; the session changes on every tick (desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:862). Reading `s` through a ref (as `local` already is) binds it once. The keymap stays pure; only the executor changes.

## Flow
- Clock running on the TV
- Before: ~3600 listener swaps an hour
- After: one binding; the handler reads the latest session from a ref

## Expected impact
Less churn on the Stick's main thread; no behaviour change intended. Could break: a key handled against a stale session if the ref lags a render.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - listener churn per session message
Before: 1 remove+add per message (code read; 3600/h with the clock on)
After: 1 binding per page load (predicted)
Method: simulation - the counting harness is the instrument; not built this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: desk/src/app/tv/page.tsx:120-139 useEffect(() => { const onKey = ...; addEventListener("keydown", onKey); return () => removeEventListener(...) }, [s, post, apply])
instrument: slice-harness test of the D-pad effect (as SW7/SW8 do) counting addEventListener calls across 100 session updates: 100 today, 1 after

title: The hint and lesson screens draw a blank stage when their data is gone
body:
## Summary
HintScreen and LessonScreen return null when s.hint / s.lesson is null, so the TV shows an empty stage, while PageScreen and SentenceScreen draw an empty state.

## Description
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:153 `if (!h) return null`, :189 `if (!l) return null`; PageScreen (:112 "No page yet") and SentenceScreen (:214 "Nothing yet") draw one. The store clears lesson on a new stage-1 hint (desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:649) and empties the slot on a learner switch (:374); whether the screen can stay on hint/lesson through those is unproven. Fix: one On Air line and the band, Back returns.

## Flow
- Reach screen hint with hint null (or lesson with lesson null)
- By code: an empty fragment, no band, no caption
- Fix: a drawn empty state

## Expected impact
No blank TV a learner cannot read. Could break: nothing visible today if the state is unreachable.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every screen state is drawn
Before: 2 of 4 data screens draw nothing on missing data
After: 4 of 4 (predicted)
Method: simulation - reachability needs a store walk over every event that clears hint/lesson
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:153,189 return null
desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:112,214 drawn empty states
desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:374,649
instrument: a store walk (DESK_DATA_DIR in the OS temp dir) firing every event that sets hint or lesson to null and asserting the screen is not hint/lesson after; then an SSR test that the two screens render a band and a caption

title: The sentence screen's tense label is 26 px, under On Air's 28 px floor
body:
## Summary
The label under the learner's tense and time marker (.tok::after) is 26 px and carries the meaning alone.

## Description
desk/src/design/on-air.css .tok::after font-size 26px, content attr(data-l) = "time marker · finished time" or the conflicting tense (desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:225). docs/DESIGN-ON-AIR.md:82: "Nothing below 28 px except labels at 20-22 px, which are furniture and never carry meaning alone"; this label is the sentence screen's verdict. Fix: 28-30 px, checked against the 92 px sentence above it.

## Flow
- Say a sentence with a time marker
- The label naming the marker's tense is drawn at 26 px
- Fix to the floor and capture the screen

## Expected impact
Readable from the sofa. Could break: a long label running past the sentence width.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - meaning-bearing text at or above the floor
Before: 1 meaning-bearing rule at 26 px (.tok::after)
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - the layout effect needs a TV capture; no dev server this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a TV capture of the sentence screen with the longest label at 1920x1080 before and after, plus a CSS scan of on-air.css font sizes against the doc table

title: The /probe hydration check ships as a production route
body:
## Summary
desk/src/app/probe/page.tsx, a dev-server hydration probe, is served in every build.

## Description
desk/src/app/probe/page.tsx: "Does anything hydrate on this dev server?". No tool, test or doc in the tree opens /probe (grep "/probe|__probe" over desk, tools, docs: only context-map.json and old challenge cards list the file). Fix: notFound() when NODE_ENV is production, keeping it for the operator's dev servers.

## Flow
- next build && next start
- /probe answers with the counter page
- Fix: 404 in production, unchanged in dev

## Expected impact
One fewer stray route on the LAN desk. Could break: an operator habit of opening /probe on a production build.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - production surface carries only product routes
Before: 1 diagnostic route served in production
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - needs a production build to observe
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/app/probe/page.tsx
grep -rn "/probe|__probe" desk tools docs: 0 consumers
instrument: render Probe with NODE_ENV=production in a test and assert notFound is thrown; or the next build route list
